simple.meaning: שִׁבְעִים (shibʻîym) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “seventy.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 91 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, and 15 more, beginning at Genesis 4:24. Its contexts include family, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁבְעִים (H7657).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
